hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A custom-curve hook implementing 1:1 ETH/phiEth swaps. In `beforeSwap`, the hook takes the input token, calls `phiEth.deposit` or `phiEth.withdraw` to convert it, then settles the output—bypassing the concentrated liquidity AMM entirely. Adding liquidity is blocked. Pool initialization is restricted to ETH/phiEth pairs with zero fee.
